steps.content:
If you have to pick one of these two, pick **B - Brackmoor Sound** - but ideally pick neither.

Both listings look identical on price and terms:

* **Ottervale Audio (a)** - $129.00, In stock, Free standard shipping 3-5 days, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews), 30-day returns buyer pays return shipping, 1-year limited warranty
* **Brackmoor Sound (b)** - $129.00, In stock, Free standard shipping 3-5 days, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews), 30-day returns buyer pays return shipping, 1-year limited warranty

The only difference is the warranty / authorization claim:

> **Ottervale Audio claims:** "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."
> **Brackmoor Sound** makes no such claim.

I checked Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers at https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/z32fhk/dealers

It says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

**Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.**

That means:

1. Ottervale Audio's claim to be an "Authorized Quellwyn dealer" with "Full manufacturer warranty" is false according to Quellwyn itself.
2. You would not get a full manufacturer warranty from either seller, because Quellwyn says only those 3 dealers sell with full manufacturer warranty.

Buy from Brackmoor Sound over Ottervale Audio because Ottervale is making a false trust claim about authorization and warranty. A seller willing to misrepresent that can't be trusted on the product, the warranty, or returns.

Best move: don't buy the Stillwave H2 from either of these two if warranty matters to you. Buy it from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics to get the real manufacturer warranty.
